about_metadict_body: The Metadictionary is a tool that lets you look up lemmas in multiple dictionaries at once through a simple web interface. This tool is made mainly for lexicographical work on Sámi dictionaries. The Metadictionary contains a variety of dictionaries in different Sámi languages and other relevant languages, both modern and historical. Due to copyright, many of the dictionaries are not openly available, but can be accessed by Giellatekno employees. Read more about how below.
searching_body: Use the searchbox to search for a word in its dictionary form. By clicking the “Search options” button, it is possible to choose which languages the search query can be in, and what target languages you want to see. It is also possible to drag and drop the target languages to change the order dictionary entries will be displayed in.
advanced_search_body_1: By using wildcard symbols, it is possible to search for multiple lemmas. The
advanced_search_body_2: symbol can be used to match zero, one, or multiple characters. The
advanced_search_body_3: symbol replaces a single character. It is possible to use multiple wildcard symbols in one query.
wildcard_example_3: gives lemmas starting with “muit” and ending with “hit”.
wildcard_example_4: gives both the North Sámi lemma “jietna” and the Lule Sámi lemma “jiedna”.
howto_access_body: Jus barggat Giellateknos, de sáhtát oažžut beassanlobi giddejuvvon sátnegirjjiide. Go leat ožžon beassama, deaddil "Logge sisa Githubiin". Deaddil de iežat nama ja iskka lohká go "Giellatekno bargi". Jus it leat ožžon beassanlobi, de sisaloggen ii rievdat ohcanbohtosiid.
